definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 defines procedure as 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division' and §2023:3.145 as 'paragraph, section, or one or more successive paragraphs or sections that include the executable code'; the rule uses the word only inside the fixed term 'procedure division header', which neither definition governs, so the programs the rule reaches are unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: The screen matched these clauses on the word 'corresponding' (14.6.4 size error and 14.6.6 arithmetic statements, whose trigger includes the CORRESPONDING phrase); here the word is only 'the corresponding formal parameter' of the procedure division header. The rule rests on nothing in §2002:14.6.4 or 14.6.6: no arithmetic statement, size error or CORRESPONDING phrase is involved, so no change of scope or evidence.

band-formats.answer: The 2002 band FORMAT 3 is the program-prototype format; 2023 merged 2002's Format 1 (on-overflow, archaic: §2002:14.8.4.1 'NOTE ON OVERFLOW is an archaic feature') and Format 2 (on-exception) into its Format 1, so the program-prototype format became Format 2. The two program-prototype diagrams are identical phrase for phrase (AS NESTED / program-prototype-name-1, BY REFERENCE identifier-2 | OMITTED, BY CONTENT and BY VALUE with arithmetic-expression-1, boolean-expression-1, identifier-4, literal-2, RETURNING, ON / NOT ON EXCEPTION), and neither band reaches the on-overflow or on-exception formats. No 2002 format is left unreached; no split.
